# Assessment — #506: Reconcile app styling to the setup-wizard design language (normal modes)

_Codebase assessment against 0.13.0-beta.3 (2026-07-12). Effort: **L**._

## Current state (already merged)

The route/infrastructure prerequisites are all done, but the actual styling reconciliation is mostly NOT done. Done already: (1) The runtime-modes route split shipped (plan docs/technical/ui-runtime-modes-plan.md marks Phases 0-5 DONE): /splash is gone; packages/ui/src/routes/ now has chat/, host/, attention/, connections/ (+connections/new alias that redirects to /connections?new=1). (2) /attention already uses the wizard shell and vocabulary — packages/ui/src/routes/attention/+page.svelte:15-37 uses wiz-topbar/wiz-wordmark/wiz-eyebrow/wiz-title/wiz-lede. (3) The shared design vocabulary was extracted: all wiz-* classes plus the Stillness tokens now live in packages/ui-kit/src/lib/theme/tokens.css (header comment lines 1-6 documents it as the shared vocabulary, extracted per #555/P5a), and both packages/ui/src/app.css:6 and packages/client/src/app.css:7 @import it. (4) The shared components named in the issue all exist with tests in packages/ui-kit/src/lib/components/common/ (SelectableCard, SettingToggle, RadioRow, FormField, Panel, plus EmptyState, PasswordInput, Drawer, etc.). (5) The UX gate exists: packages/ui/package.json:22-23 has ux:audit and ux:audit:wizard driving e2e/ux-audit.config.json and e2e/ux-audit.wizard.config.json. NOT done: (a) Wizard component adoption (the absorbed #458): zero of SelectableCard/SettingToggle/RadioRow/FormField/Panel are imported anywhere under packages/ui/src/routes/setup/ — every step (9 files, ~2,900 lines) hand-rolls its own cards/toggles/panels in per-file <style> blocks, e.g. Screen2ExtrasStep.svelte lines 119-127 hand-rolls toggle-track/toggle-thumb markup and lines 295+ duplicate the toggle/card CSS that SettingToggle already encapsulates; Screen1ModelsStep.svelte hand-rolls its radio-row layout. (b) /connections does NOT use the wizard language: packages/ui/src/routes/connections/+page.svelte uses a plain page-header h1 + .lede, hand-rolled .connection-card, raw label/input .field markup instead of FormField/PasswordInput/Panel, and no wiz-eyebrow/wiz-title/wiz-lede — it reads as an admin panel. The same is true of its client-side copy, packages/client/src/routes/connections/+page.svelte (650 lines, adapted from the ui one per its header comment). (c) Chat empty state: packages/ui/src/routes/chat/+page.svelte (the Stillness s-* rebuild) has NO empty-state branch at all — when chat.entries is empty the thread is simply blank (only s-loading/s-pending states exist around lines 478-522); rubric category 7 requires icon + 1-2 sentences + one action. packages/client/src/routes/chat/+page.svelte likewise has no designed empty state. Chat shell chrome itself (Stillness corners, veil, tool rail) is already calm/low-density and built on the same tokens the wizard uses. (d) ux-audit.config.json covers only chat + /host admin states — no connections or attention states, so the acceptance gate cannot currently exercise the surfaces this issue targets. (e) The wiz-* vocabulary is 'documented' only via the tokens.css header comment; no doc declares it the shared normal-mode vocabulary, and only setup + attention consume it. Complication the issue predates: Phase 5 (#555) duplicated the normal-mode surfaces into packages/client (routes/chat, routes/connections) with a ratified parity contract (plan §12.2, pinned by packages/client/e2e/parity-contract.pw.ts), so 'normal modes' now means two apps.

## Test strategy

packages/ui runs vitest with two projects (packages/ui/vite.config.ts lines 77-104): a chromium browser project for co-located *.svelte.vitest.ts component tests (this project also executes packages/ui-kit's component tests — ui-kit itself has no vitest setup, its package.json 'test' is bun test) and a node project for *.vitest.ts. Command: cd packages/ui && npm run test:unit -- --run (browser project needs 'npm run test:browsers' first; per plan §12.6 the Playwright browser download is proxy-blocked in the dev container, so browser-project runs may need CI or a real machine). Test-first approach: (1) extend packages/ui/src/routes/setup/steps/Screen1ModelsStep.svelte.vitest.ts (existing) to assert the step renders ui-kit RadioRow/SelectableCard roles/testids before refactoring, and add a Screen2ExtrasStep.svelte.vitest.ts asserting SettingToggle's switch role replaces the hand-rolled toggle; ui-kit component behavior is already covered by SettingToggle.svelte.vitest.ts / RadioRow.svelte.vitest.ts / SelectableCardHarness.svelte.vitest.ts. (2) For chat empty state, add assertions to the existing chat page tests (packages/ui/src/routes/page.svelte.vitest.ts pattern) that an empty entries list renders the EmptyState with one action. (3) packages/client: cd packages/client && bun test for unit, npx playwright test for e2e — connections-form.pw.ts, axe-scan.pw.ts, and parity-contract.pw.ts must stay green after restyling. (4) Static gates: npm run check (svelte-check) in packages/ui and packages/ui-kit. (5) Acceptance gate: cd packages/ui && npm run ux:audit (e2e/ux-audit.config.json, states extended per remaining work) and npm run ux:audit:wizard, 11 widths x light/dark screenshots into .reviews/, then the 3-judge rubric panel per docs/technical/ui-design-rubric.md.

## Dependencies (0.13.0 open issues)

- No hard blockers among the open 0.13.0 issues: the route-structure prerequisite this issue named (#486 /connections, and the broader Phase 1-5 route split) is already merged and marked DONE in docs/technical/ui-runtime-modes-plan.md §10.
- #511 (PWA, Phase 6) — soft coordination, not a blocker: it works in packages/client, where the duplicated chat/connections surfaces live; landing the connections/chat-empty-state restyle as shared ui-kit components (rather than per-app CSS) avoids merge churn with #511's client work and keeps the §12.2 parity surfaces from drifting.

## Risks

- Two normal-mode apps since the #555 split: styling only packages/ui regresses visual parity with packages/client (whose chat/connections were copied pre-restyle); the parity contract e2e pins behavior, not appearance, so drift would be silent.
- Wizard steps carry behavioral tests and audit selectors (data-testid step-models/step-extras, .btn-empty-install, .step-content used by e2e/ux-audit.wizard.config.json and Screen1ModelsStep.svelte.vitest.ts) — component adoption must preserve them or the gate breaks.
- packages/ui chat (+page.svelte, 1,597 lines, Stillness) is slated for eventual deletion once client voice parity lands (plan §12.2 ratified option (b)) — empty-state work invested only there is throwaway; build it shared in ui-kit.
- The browser-project vitest suite cannot run in the dev container (Playwright chromium download is proxy-blocked, plan §12.6), so component-test verification may have to happen in CI.
- npm run ux:audit depends on external AKM skill scripts ($AKM_HOME/skills/web-ux/ux-dom-audit) and a live dev server with auth; /attention additionally redirects away unless a blocking migration is pending, making its audit state awkward to capture without a fixture.
- SettingToggle/RadioRow ui-kit components were built during extraction (#555) without wizard adoption; their APIs may not cover wizard needs (e.g. Screen2ExtrasStep's expanding addon-panel under each toggle, icon slots), forcing ui-kit API changes that ripple to existing consumers (providers forms, admin tabs).

## Original issue body

# #506: Reconcile app styling to the setup-wizard design language (normal modes)

## Goal

Bring the **normal user-facing modes** onto one consistent, friendly, low-density design language modeled on the setup wizard. Admin/Advanced stay denser by design.

## Route changes (0.13.0 — coordinate with runtime modes plan)

The runtime modes refactor (`docs/technical/ui-runtime-modes-plan.md`) changes the route structure this issue targets:

| Old route | New route | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/splash` | Split into `/chat`, `/host`, `/attention`, `/connections/new` | `/splash` is removed |
| `/admin/*` | `/host/*` | Direct rename, no alias |
| (none) | `/connections` | New — connection management |
| (none) | `/assistant/settings` | New — assistant-owned settings |

**Implication:** this issue should target the new routes, not `/splash`. The wizard design language should propagate to `/chat` (empty state + framing), `/connections`, and `/attention`.

## Scope

- [ ] **Chat** — reconcile chat empty-state and shell chrome to wizard design language (calm, low-density). Message list/composer functional density unchanged.
- [ ] **`/connections`** — new route; should feel like an extension of the wizard (same language, not an admin panel).
- [ ] **`/attention`** — migration/blocking landing; use wizard shell + eyebrow/title/lede typography.
- [ ] **Wizard component adoption (absorbs #458)** — wizard steps still use inline classes; refactor onto shared components (`SelectableCard`, `SettingToggle`, `RadioRow`, `FormField`, `Panel`) so the extraction is real.
- [ ] **Shared design vocabulary** — `wiz-eyebrow` / `wiz-title` / `wiz-lede` become documented shared classes used by all normal-mode routes, not just the wizard.
- [ ] **Splash** — already migrated in 0.12.0; will be removed in 0.13.0 as part of the route split. Carry the design language forward to the successor routes.

## Out of scope

- `/host/*` (admin) and `/advanced` — denser by design, not targeted here.

## Acceptance

- Normal modes read as one family (wizard ↔ chat ↔ connections ↔ attention).
- Wizard steps consume shared components; no duplicated inline card/toggle CSS.
- Changes clear the web-UX gate (`npm run ux:audit` + 3-judge panel) per `docs/technical/ui-design-rubric.md`, width sweep + light/dark.

## References

- `docs/technical/ui-runtime-modes-plan.md` — route structure this issue must coordinate with
- Splash landing rebuild (0.12.0): `packages/ui/src/routes/splash/+page.svelte`
- Wizard design language: `app.css` + `packages/ui/src/routes/setup/steps/`
- Shared components: `packages/ui/src/lib/components/common/`
- UX gate / rubric: `docs/technical/ui-design-rubric.md`
- Supersedes/absorbs #458.
